app.name: aione
debtEnforcement.title: Debt enforcement
estimate.warning: Planning estimate only. Verify against official documents or with the competent authority.
onboarding.step1.title: Where will aione be used?
onboarding.step1.text: Country, region and municipality determine terminology, tax data and legal notices later.
onboarding.jurisdiction.help: These details control regional features. Tax and authority values remain planning values and must be checked against official documents.
onboarding.step2.title: Language and base currency
onboarding.step2.text: The base currency is used for summaries and forecasts. Individual accounts may still use other currencies.
onboarding.french.pending: French is already prepared as a separate language file. Full activation for the older interface follows with the translation migration.
onboarding.currency.help: Switzerland normally starts with CHF and Germany with EUR. You can deliberately change this.
onboarding.step3.title: Which account is your starting point?
onboarding.step3.text: aione needs at least one account with a realistic current balance. The balance may also be negative.
onboarding.balance.help: Use the balance from which aione should continue calculating. An overdrawn account can be entered as a negative amount.
onboarding.step4.title: Review the foundation
onboarding.step4.text: These details are the starting point for planning, forecasts and regional features.
onboarding.verify.warning: Note: aione supports financial planning. Tax, debt-enforcement and authority information is not a binding decision. Verify relevant values and deadlines with official documents or the competent authority.
onboarding.error.region: Please choose a canton or state.
onboarding.error.municipality: Please enter your municipality or place of residence.
debt.title: Debt enforcement · Switzerland
debt.intro: Track outstanding claims, payments already made and an estimated remaining timeline. Payroll garnishments can be recorded separately from bank transactions.
debt.chOnly: This area is initially available for Switzerland in Beta 69. Germany will use separate legal logic.
debt.warning.title: Important notice
debt.warning.text: aione provides a planning overview, not an official enforcement balance. Interest, fees, additional claims, garnishment changes and authority decisions can change the actual balance and duration. Always verify against official documents or the competent authority.
debt.summary.activeHelp: Open or paused with a balance
debt.empty.title: No debt-enforcement case yet
debt.empty.text: First record the known claim. Then add payments from payroll, bank transactions or manual records.
debt.monthlyRate.help: Optional. Used only to estimate the remaining duration.
debt.projection.missing: No estimate without a monthly amount
debt.projection.warning: The remaining duration is an estimate based on the current balance and entered monthly amount. It is not an official end date.
debt.status.label: Status
debt.payment.help: For wage garnishment, record the amount actually deducted on the payslip. It may not appear as a separate debit on the bank account.
debt.confirmDelete: Delete this case including its payment history?
debt.error.bridge: The aione data connection is not ready yet.
